title: Full Stack Developer (Contract)
description:
**Job Description**

We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Developer to join our team on a 2\-month contract. The ideal candidate should be able to independently handle development tasks, work across both frontend and backend, and deliver projects within defined timelines.

**Important: This is a 2\-month contract\-based opportunity. Immediate joiners who can work full\-time from our Science City office are preferred.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend.
* Build responsive and user\-friendly interfaces.
* Develop and integrate APIs and backend services.
* Work with databases and ensure efficient data handling.
* Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues.
* Write clean, maintainable, and scalable code.
* Work closely with the team to understand requirements and deliver tasks on time.
* Test and optimise applications for performance and reliability.
* Take ownership of assigned development tasks and complete them within deadlines.

**For further query you can contact us on \+91 9016794075** 

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹60,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

title: Frontend Full Stack Developer
description:
Position: Frontend Full Stack Developer

**Gender:** Male/Female  
**Experience:** 4 years

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, customize, and maintain responsive, user\-facing web applications and interfaces.
* Build and implement UI components using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and React.js / Next.js.
* Design and develop backend services, REST/GraphQL APIs, and database schemas using Node.js (Express/NestJS) or equivalent.
* Translate UI/UX designs and wireframes into high\-quality, reusable code across the stack.
* Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and third\-party services.
* Optimize applications for maximum speed, performance, and cross\-browser/cross\-device compatibility.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code following coding standards.
* Troubleshoot and resolve bugs, layout issues, and performance bottlenecks across frontend and backend.
* Implement responsive design and ensure accessibility (WCAG) best practices.
* Leverage AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, etc.) to accelerate development, debugging, and code review.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend/DevOps teams, and project managers to deliver features on time.
* Participate in code reviews, unit testing, and version control workflows.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* 4\+ years of experience in full stack web development.
* Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6\+), and responsive/mobile\-first design.
* Mandatory hands\-on experience with React.js and Next.js.
* Backend experience with Node.js and frameworks like Express or NestJS.
* Experience with databases (MongoDB, MySQL, or PostgreSQL) and API design (REST/GraphQL).
* Familiarity with state management (Redux, Vuex, Context API, etc.).
* Experience with CSS preprocessors (SASS/LESS) and CSS frameworks (Tailwind, Bootstrap).
* Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Mandatory working knowledge of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, etc.) for day\-to\-day development.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with TypeScript.
* Familiarity with testing frameworks (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress).
* Basic understanding of SEO principles and web performance optimization (Core Web Vitals).
* Exposure to cloud deployment and CI/CD pipelines.

Pay: ₹600,000\.00 \- ₹700,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Project Coordinator

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
**About Us**

Maharshi Industries Pvt Ltd (MIPL) is a leader in Robotics, Artificial Intelligence, and Virtual Reality Simulation systems, serving Defence, Police, Railways, Oil \& Gas, and Industrial sectors under the *Make in India* initiative. We are seeking a skilled **Full Stack Developer** to design and build advanced **Graphical User Interfaces (GUIs)** for our cutting\-edge **VR and AI\-driven products and platforms**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop **responsive, intuitive GUIs** for VR and AI\-based applications.
* Collaborate with **VR developers, AI engineers, and robotics teams** to integrate backend logic with interactive frontends.
* Build **cross\-platform dashboards** for real\-time data visualization, control, and monitoring of AI/VR systems.
* Develop APIs and middleware to ensure smooth communication between **AI modules, VR simulations, and hardware devices**.
* Optimize applications for **performance, scalability, and security**.
* Participate in **code reviews, testing, and debugging** to maintain high\-quality deliverables.
* Document technical workflows and provide support for integration and deployment.

**Required Skills \& Technologies**

**Frontend Development**

* Strong in **JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3**.
* Experience with modern frameworks: **React.js / Angular / Vue.js**.
* UI/UX design knowledge to build user\-friendly dashboards.

**Backend Development**

* Proficiency in **Node.js, Python (Django/Flask/FastAPI), or Java**.
* Database experience: **MySQL / PostgreSQL / MongoDB**.
* RESTful APIs and WebSocket integration.

**Integration \& Tools**

* Experience with **3D/VR libraries (Three.js, Babylon.js, Unity WebGL integration preferred)**.
* Familiarity with **AI/ML integration workflows** (Python APIs, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or ONNX runtime).
* Knowledge of **Git/GitHub, Docker, CI/CD pipelines**.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical ability.
* Ability to **collaborate with cross\-functional teams** (VR engineers, AI scientists, robotics experts).
* Strong communication skills and ownership of deliverables.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in **Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field**.
* Minimum 1–3 years of experience as a **Full Stack Developer.**
* Prior work experience with full stack development is a mandatory.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

* 1\. Have you worked on any live projects ?
